pageContent: Day 1: Intro to AI Engineering. Topic: AI Eng Fundamentals. Learning Objectives: Understand AI lifecycle, Setup environment. Tools used: Python, Docker.
Day 5: Prompt Engineering. Topic: Advanced Prompting. Learning Objectives: Chain of thought, Few-shot learning. Tools used: LangChain.
Day 12: RAG Systems. Topic: Vector Databases & RAG. Learning Objectives: Embeddings, Similarity search, Chunking strategies. Tools used: Pinecone, FAISS.
Day 18: AI Agents. Topic: Agentic Workflows. Learning Objectives: Tool use, Planning, Memory management. Tools used: LangGraph, CrewAI.
Day 25: Production AI. Topic: Deployment & Scaling. Learning Objectives: Load balancing, Model optimization, Monitoring. Tools used: Kubernetes, Ray.
Day 31: Capstone. Topic: Enterprise AI Integration. Learning Objectives: Security, Compliance, System design. Tools used: AWS, Azure.
